title: The 13th Annual Halloween Spooktacular!
summary: The 13th annual Halloween "Spooktacular" episode of Stuff You Should Know, ad-free, in which Josh and Chuck read two public domain spooky stories aloud. First, "The Boarded Window" by Ambrose Bierce, about a recluse named Merlock on the Ohio frontier whose wife dies, and a panther attacks her body. Second, "The Toll House" by W. W. Jacobs (1907), about four men who spend a night in a reputedly haunted house and are picked off one by one by sleep and phantom footsteps. The episode closes with Halloween safety tips and a joke about X-raying candy.
topics: Stuff You Should Know Halloween episode

segments.title: Opening banter and ad-free promise
segments.summary: Josh and Chuck welcome listeners to the Halloween Spooktacular, note it is one of two ad-free episodes a year, and explain they chose two public domain stories suitable for kids.

segments.title: The Boarded Window by Ambrose Bierce
segments.summary: Josh reads Ambrose Bierce's story about Merlock, a frontier recluse with a boarded-up window whose wife dies of fever. He falls asleep beside her body, wakes to a panther dragging her toward the window, and fires his rifle. The hosts discuss grief and the story's ending.

segments.title: Hosts discuss The Boarded Window and switch to the next story
segments.summary: Chuck and Josh talk about the ending and the wife's possible survival, then set up the second reading and mention W. W. Jacobs, author of The Monkey's Paw.

segments.title: The Toll House: setup
segments.summary: Chuck introduces The Toll House, a 1907 W. W. Jacobs story. The hosts joke about the name and the English setting. Josh reads the opening, in which the landlord warns that the house has claimed many lives and Barnes scoffs at ghosts.

segments.title: The four men enter the haunted house
segments.summary: The men set out at night with candles. Lester and Meagle find the door open and it is later shut. Meagle points out the place where a tramp hanged himself. They settle into a room to drink and play cards.

segments.title: White falls asleep and the footsteps begin
segments.summary: White falls into a sleep that cannot be broken, then Lester does too. Meagle is left with Barnes, who hears footsteps in the passage. Barnes chases the sounds through the house, then Meagle is found dead below the stairs.

segments.title: Morning discovery and story ending
segments.summary: Lester wakes at sunrise and finds Barnes sleeping elsewhere in the house. They find Meagle's body at the bottom of the stairs, the broken balusters at the edge of the landing.

segments.title: Hosts discuss The Toll House
segments.summary: Josh and Chuck comment on the story, the characters, and the eeriness of the empty house, and say they want to do The Monkey's Paw someday.

segments.title: Halloween sign-off and candy safety
segments.summary: Josh and Chuck wish listeners a happy Halloween, advise them to be safe, and joke about X-raying candy at the ER.
